history.name: DataExtraction_Expert
history.content:
I will fetch monthly prices for VGT, MGK, and VONG from Yahoo Finance with interval=1mo. I’ll attempt to use January 2013 and December 2023 closes. If January 2013 data is missing for any ticker, I’ll select the first valid month in 2013. Then I’ll print the start and end dates with their closing prices.

Here is the Python code to run:

```python
# filename: fetch_monthly_prices.py
import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

symbols = ["VGT", "MGK", "VONG"]
start = "2013-01-01"
end = "2023-12-31"

rows = []
for sym in symbols:
    # Fetch monthly data; using raw Close here
    data = yf.download(sym, start=start, end=end, interval="1mo", auto_adjust=False)
    # Filter to 2013–2023
    data = data[(data.index.year >= 2013) & (data.index.year <= 2023)]
    # Identify first valid month in 2013 for start
    start_mask = data.index.year == 2013
    start_2013 = data[start_mask].dropna(subset=["Close"]).iloc[0] if not data[start_mask].dropna(subset=["Close"]).empty else None
    end_mask = data.index.year == 2023
    end_2023 = data[end_mask].dropna(subset=["Close"]).iloc[-1] if not data[end_mask].dropna(subset=["Close"]).empty else None

    start_date = data[start_mask].dropna(subset=["Close"]).index[0].strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if start_2013 is not None else None
    end_date = data[end_mask].dropna(subset=["Close"]).index[-1].strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if end_2023 is not None else None

    start_price = float(start_2013["Close"]) if start_2013 is not None else None
    end_price = float(end_2023["Close"]) if end_2023 is not None else None

    rows.append({
        "ETF": sym,
        "Start Date": start_date,
        "Start Price": start_price,
        "End Date": end_date,
        "End Price": end_price
    })

out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(out)
print("\nData source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (monthly Close)")
```
